Container.Name: peaks-vr
Container.Overview: peaks-vr — taste-driven moment discovery for VR video. Everything is driven from the WebGUI at [IP]:8801 — no console needed. The EMBED tab scans your library (mounted at /data), previews the VR de-warp on any file, and runs the GPU embedding pass with a live progress bar (resumable). The FLAG tab mirrors HereSphere playback so you can heart the moments you like. To feed playback in: HereSphere reports it via its TIMESTAMP SERVER — open HereSphere's settings and set the timestamp server to THIS SERVER'S LAN IP and port 23573 (the container listens there). Embedding is GPU-hungry and needs the Nvidia Driver plugin + --runtime=nvidia; the UI + timestamp intake run CPU-only. IMPORTANT: mount your VR library at /data so file paths reported by HereSphere resolve here.

Config.Name: Timestamp server intake
Config.Description: HereSphere's timestamp server connects IN here and pushes playback. Set HereSphere's timestamp server to this server's LAN IP : this port.

Config.Name: Config / data
Config.Description: Embedding cache, ❤️ labels, trained models, and DINOv2/CLIP model downloads.

Config.Name: VR library
Config.Description: Your VR video library. Mount the share here (read-only is fine). File paths HereSphere reports should resolve under this mount for embedding/recommendations to line up.

Config.Name: PEAKS_VR_PROFILE
Config.Description: The taste profile your ❤️ marks belong to (you can keep several, e.g. apex-pov). Default: apex.

Config.Name: PEAKS_VR_REMOTE_HOST
Config.Description: Leave BLANK to receive HereSphere's timestamp server (recommended, the headset connects in). Set to the headset IP to instead DIAL the DeoVR remote (read + control) — only if your build exposes it on port 23554.

Config.Name: PEAKS_VR_BYTEORDER
Config.Description: Length-prefix endianness of the HereSphere stream. 'big' (default). If the flagging UI connects but shows no playback, try 'little'.

Config.Name: PEAKS_VR_PREVIEW
Config.Description: Set to 1 to show a live de-warped frame preview in the UI (needs ffmpeg + the scene embedded; GPU recommended). Blank = off.

Config.Name: NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES
Config.Description: Which GPU(s) the container may use ('all', or a GPU UUID from Settings > Nvidia Driver).

Config.Name: NVIDIA_DRIVER_CAPABILITIES
Config.Description: Leave as 'all' (compute for embedding + video for NVDEC decode).
